text:
maria_writer: Quick FYI — noticed after the TOC reorg yesterday some internal anchors in /docs/integrations/k8s-setup are 404ing in the staging preview. Not urgent but causing a failing docs smoke check.

link-bot: link-scan: 7 broken anchors in /docs/integrations/k8s-setup detected -> https://scans.internal/3333331234 (auto)

maria_writer: example from preview: `/docs/integrations/k8s-setup.md#pod-startup-order` -> 404. We renamed headings during the reorg and lost stable ids.

lisa: @maria_writer I can take ownership of the anchor fixes. Can you list the heading changes so I can add redirects?

maria_writer: Sure — old headings vs new: `Pod startup order` -> now `Ordering of pods at startup`, `Init containers` -> `Init-container behavior`. I think adding explicit HTML anchors or a redirect mapping will be safest.

kevin_sre: If you add redirects, please include them in the docs-redirects.yaml so runtime redirects pick them up at build time. Sample snippet:```yaml
- from: "/docs/integrations/k8s-setup#pod-startup-order"
  to: "/docs/integrations/k8s-setup#ordering-of-pods-at-startup"
```
This prevents broken internal references and preserves old links from emails.

tom_infra: Heads-up: the staging preview caches shortlinks for 12h. After you merge the mapping, ping me and I'll purge the docs CDN for that path so preview shows the fix immediately.

lisa: I'll open a focused PR `docs/k8s-anchor-redirects` with the YAML mapping + tiny README note about anchor stability. @pr-bot can you run the docs lint in the PR checks with `--anchors`?

pr-bot: queued checks: docs-lint, markdown-link-check, docs-anchors (requested by lisa).

maria_writer: thanks. Also adding a one-liner in the changelog so we can track the reorg followups.

kevin_sre: After merge, can we get a quick canary smoke? I'll schedule the canary job. @tom_infra please coordinate the CDN purge after CI green.

lisa: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4021 — small mapping + tests. tagging @maria_writer for verification.

maria_writer: verified locally, tests pass. Thanks @lisa — adding a short note to the runbook to include `docs-link-scan --anchors` in the post-merge checklist.

pr-bot: PR 4021: all checks passed. docs-anchors OK.

kevin_sre: queued canary smoke (job 7723). Will report back in ~15m. :eyes:

tom_infra: CDN purge requested for `/docs/integrations/k8s-setup` path after canary passes.

kevin_sre: Canary passed, no more 404s in staging preview. :tada:

maria_writer: amazing — thanks folks. Filing a tiny follow-up to audit other reorged pages tomorrow.

lisa: thanks everyone, closing the loop.
